title: The Merino-Welsh conjecture for sparse and dense graphs

definitions.name: x2611_15008_components
definitions.lean:
noncomputable def x2611_15008_components {V E : Type*} (G : Graph V E) : ℕ :=
  Nat.card G.toSimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent
definitions.notes: Number of connected components, including isolated vertices, of Mathlib’s multigraph. Passing to toSimpleGraph discards loops and repeated adjacency only for connectivity; the vertex set is exactly G.vertexSet.

definitions.name: x2611_15008_contract
definitions.notes: Contraction of S: identify vertices by the equivalence relation generated by the endpoints of edges in S, use Graph.map to retain loops and distinct edge identities, then delete S. This implements the contraction convention in Section 2.

definitions.name: x2611_15008_bridge
definitions.lean:
noncomputable def x2611_15008_bridge {V E : Type*} (G : Graph V E) (e : E) : Prop :=
  e ∈ G.edgeSet ∧ x2611_15008_components G < x2611_15008_components (G.deleteEdges {e})
definitions.notes: An edge of G whose deletion increases the number of connected components, counting isolated vertices, exactly as defined in Section 2. Used only with finite graphs.

definitions.name: x2611_15008_parallelClass
definitions.lean:
def x2611_15008_parallelClass {V E : Type*} (G : Graph V E) (e : E) : Set E :=
  {f | ∃ u v, u ≠ v ∧ G.IsLink e u v ∧ G.IsLink f u v}
definitions.notes: The full parallel class of a non-loop edge: all edges with the same unordered, distinct endpoints. Empty on a loop; every use of this definition has the non-loop domain condition.

definitions.name: x2611_15008_seriesClass
definitions.lean:
noncomputable def x2611_15008_seriesClass {V E : Type*} (G : Graph V E) (e : E) : Set E :=
  {f | e ∈ G.edgeSet ∧ f ∈ G.edgeSet ∧ ¬ x2611_15008_bridge G e ∧
    ¬ x2611_15008_bridge G f ∧
    (e = f ∨ x2611_15008_components G < x2611_15008_components (G.deleteEdges {e, f}))}
definitions.notes: The full series class of a non-bridge edge: non-bridge edges f equal to e or such that deleting {e,f} increases the component count. With both edges non-bridges and e≠f, this is exactly a two-edge cocircuit. Loops have singleton series classes. Empty outside the non-bridge domain.

definitions.name: x2611_15008_multipleBridge
definitions.lean:
noncomputable def x2611_15008_multipleBridge {V E : Type*} (G : Graph V E) (e : E) : Prop :=
  x2611_15008_bridge (G.deleteEdges (x2611_15008_parallelClass G e \ {e})) e
definitions.notes: The paper’s definition: e is a bridge after all other edges in its parallel class have been deleted.

definitions.name: x2611_15008_subdividedLoop
definitions.lean:
noncomputable def x2611_15008_subdividedLoop {V E : Type*} (G : Graph V E) (e : E) : Prop :=
  ∃ v, (x2611_15008_contract G (x2611_15008_seriesClass G e \ {e})).IsLoopAt e v
definitions.notes: The paper’s definition: e is a loop after contracting every other edge in its series class.

definitions.name: x2611_15008_Tutte
definitions.lean:
noncomputable def x2611_15008_Tutte {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] (G : Graph V E) (x y : ℝ) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact G.edgeSet.toFinset.powerset.sum (fun A =>
    (x - 1) ^ (x2611_15008_components (G.restrict (A : Set E)) - x2611_15008_components G) *
    (y - 1) ^ (A.card + x2611_15008_components (G.restrict (A : Set E)) - G.vertexSet.ncard))
definitions.notes: Real evaluation of the Tutte polynomial by its finite spanning-subgraph expansion: sum over A⊆E(G) of (x−1)^(κ(A)−κ(G)) (y−1)^(|A|+κ(A)−|V(G)|). Edge identities preserve multiple edges; loops contribute to nullity. Graph.restrict retains isolated vertices. For finite graphs both natural exponents are nonnegative, so natural subtraction is exact. No conjecture or lemma from the paper is assumed in this definition.

statements.label: Theorem 2 (loopless inequality)
statements.name: x2611_15008_thm2_loopless
statements.original:
Theorem 2.

Let $a>0,~b>1$ so that $1+ka\leq 2b^{k}$ for all integers $k\geq 1$ and $G$ be a graph with $n$ vertices, $m$ edges and $\kappa$ connected components. Then

$\displaystyle\frac{T_{G}(1,1)}{T_{G}(2,0)}\leq\frac{b^{m}}{a^{n-\kappa}}$ 
 $\displaystyle\text{if $G$ is loopless, and}$
statements.lean: (V E : Type*) [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : Graph V E) (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 1 < b) (hab : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → 1 + (k : ℝ) * a ≤ 2 * b ^ k) (hG : G.Loopless) : x2611_15008_Tutte G 1 1 / x2611_15008_Tutte G 2 0 ≤ b ^ G.edgeSet.ncard / a ^ (G.vertexSet.ncard - x2611_15008_components G)
statements.notes: Finite multigraphs are represented by Mathlib Graph with finite ambient vertex and edge types; every finite multigraph has such a representation. Counts use the actual vertex/edge sets, not the ambient type sizes. First inequality only. The parameter condition over positive natural k is equivalent to the printed condition over integers k≥1. n−κ is a natural exponent. The ratio is real division; no positivity hypothesis for the denominator is added.

fidelity.twin: {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] (G : Graph V E) (hfinite : G.vertexSet.Finite) (n m κ : ℕ) (hn : G.vertexSet.ncard = n) (hm : G.edgeSet.ncard = m) (hκ : x2611_15008_components G = κ) (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 1 < b) (hab : ∀ k : ℤ, 1 ≤ k → 1 + (k : ℝ) * a ≤ 2 * b ^ k) (hloopless : G.Loopless) : x2611_15008_Tutte G 1 1 / x2611_15008_Tutte G 2 0 ≤ b ^ m / a ^ (n - κ)
fidelity.equivalence_proof:
theorem x2611_15008_thm2_loopless_eqv_aux_transport
    {V E W F : Type*} [Fintype E] [Fintype F] (G : Graph V E)
    (v : G.vertexSet ≃ W) (e : E ≃ F) :
    ∃ H : Graph W F,
      H.vertexSet.ncard = G.vertexSet.ncard ∧
      H.edgeSet.ncard = G.edgeSet.ncard ∧
      x2611_15008_components H = x2611_15008_components G ∧
      (∀ x y : ℝ, x2611_15008_Tutte H x y = x2611_15008_Tutte G x y) ∧
      (G.Loopless → H.Loopless) := by
  classical
  let H : Graph W F :=
    { vertexSet := Set.univ
      edgeSet := e '' G.edgeSet
      IsLink := fun f u w => G.IsLink (e.symm f) (v.symm u).val (v.symm w).val
      isLink_symm := fun _ _ => ⟨fun _ _ h => h.symm⟩
      eq_or_eq_of_isLink_of_isLink := by
        intro f x y z w h h'
        exact (h.left_eq_or_eq h').imp
          (fun h => v.symm.injective (Subtype.ext h))
          (fun h => v.symm.injective (Subtype.ext h))
      edge_mem_iff_exists_isLink := by
        intro f
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
          obtain ⟨u, w, huw⟩ := G.exists_isLink_of_mem_edgeSet hf
          refine ⟨v ⟨u, huw.left_mem⟩, v ⟨w, huw.right_mem⟩, ?_⟩
          simpa using huw
        · rintro ⟨u, w, huw⟩
          exact ⟨e.symm f, huw.edge_mem, e.apply_symm_apply f⟩
      left_mem_of_isLink := fun _ _ _ _ => Set.mem_univ _ }
  have hv : H.vertexSet.ncard = G.vertexSet.ncard := by
    change (Set.univ : Set W).ncard = _
    rw [Set.ncard_univ, ← Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
    exact Nat.card_congr v.symm
  have he : H.edgeSet.ncard = G.edgeSet.ncard :=
    Set.ncard_image_of_injective G.edgeSet e.injective
  have hc : ∀ S : Set E,
      x2611_15008_components (H.restrict (e '' S)) =
        x2611_15008_components (G.restrict S) := by
    intro S
    let i : (H.restrict (e '' S)).toSimpleGraph ≃g (G.restrict S).toSimpleGraph :=
      { toEquiv := (Equiv.Set.univ W).trans v.symm
        map_rel_iff' := by
          intro u w
          change (v.symm u.val ≠ v.symm w.val ∧
            ∃ f, f ∈ S ∧ G.IsLink f (v.symm u.val).val (v.symm w.val).val) ↔
            (u ≠ w ∧ ∃ f, f ∈ e '' S ∧
              G.IsLink (e.symm f) (v.symm u.val).val (v.symm w.val).val)
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨hne, f, hf, hlink⟩
            refine ⟨fun h => hne (congrArg (fun z => v.symm z.val) h),
              e f, ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
            simpa using hlink
          · rintro ⟨hne, _, ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩, hlink⟩
            refine ⟨fun h => hne (Subtype.ext (v.symm.injective h)), f, hf, ?_⟩
            simpa using hlink }
    exact Nat.card_congr i.connectedComponentEquiv
  have hc0 : x2611_15008_components H = x2611_15008_components G := by
    have h := hc G.edgeSet
    change x2611_15008_components (H.restrict H.edgeSet) =
      x2611_15008_components (G.restrict G.edgeSet) at h
    simpa only [Graph.restrict_self] using h
  have hT : ∀ x y : ℝ, x2611_15008_Tutte H x y = x2611_15008_Tutte G x y := by
    intro x y
    unfold x2611_15008_Tutte
    apply Finset.sum_bij (fun A _ => A.image e.symm)
    · intro A hA
      apply Finset.mem_powerset.mpr
      intro f hf
      obtain ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hf
      have hgH : g ∈ H.edgeSet := by
        simpa only [Set.mem_toFinset] using ((Finset.mem_powerset.mp hA) hg)
      change g ∈ e '' G.edgeSet at hgH
      obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := hgH
      simpa only [Set.mem_toFinset, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using hq
    · intro A _ B _ h
      exact Finset.image_injective e.symm.injective h
    · intro B hB
      refine ⟨B.image e, ?_, by simp [Finset.image_image]⟩
      apply Finset.mem_powerset.mpr
      intro f hf
      obtain ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hf
      have hgG : g ∈ G.edgeSet := by
        simpa only [Set.mem_toFinset] using ((Finset.mem_powerset.mp hB) hg)
      have hgH : e g ∈ H.edgeSet := ⟨g, hgG, rfl⟩
      simpa only [Set.mem_toFinset] using hgH
    · intro A _
      have himage : e '' (↑(A.image e.symm) : Set E) = (A : Set F) := by
        simp [Finset.coe_image, Set.image_image]
      have hcomp := hc (↑(A.image e.symm) : Set E)
      rw [himage] at hcomp
      rw [hcomp, hc0, hv, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ e.symm.injective]
  refine ⟨H, hv, he, hc0, hT, ?_⟩
  intro hG
  exact ⟨fun f u => hG.not_isLoopAt (e.symm f) (v.symm u).val⟩

theorem x2611_15008_thm2_loopless_eqv_aux_apply
    {W F V E : Type*} [Fintype F] [Fintype E] (a b : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ H : Graph W F, H.vertexSet.Finite → H.Loopless →
      x2611_15008_Tutte H 1 1 / x2611_15008_Tutte H 2 0 ≤
        b ^ H.edgeSet.ncard / a ^ (H.vertexSet.ncard - x2611_15008_components H))
    (G : Graph V E) (v : G.vertexSet ≃ W) (e : E ≃ F)
    (hfinite : G.vertexSet.Finite) (hG : G.Loopless) :
    x2611_15008_Tutte G 1 1 / x2611_15008_Tutte G 2 0 ≤
      b ^ G.edgeSet.ncard / a ^ (G.vertexSet.ncard - x2611_15008_components G) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨H, hv, he, hc, hT, hloop⟩ :=
    x2611_15008_thm2_loopless_eqv_aux_transport G v e
  let _ : Fintype G.vertexSet := hfinite.fintype
  let _ : Fintype W := Fintype.ofEquiv G.vertexSet v
  have hH := h H (Set.toFinite _) (hloop hG)
  simpa only [hv, he, hc, hT] using hH

theorem x2611_15008_thm2_loopless_eqv : (∀ (V E : Type*) [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : Graph V E) (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 1 < b) (hab : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → 1 + (k : ℝ) * a ≤ 2 * b ^ k) (hG : G.Loopless), x2611_15008_Tutte G 1 1 / x2611_15008_Tutte G 2 0 ≤ b ^ G.edgeSet.ncard / a ^ (G.vertexSet.ncard - x2611_15008_components G)) ↔ (∀ {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] (G : Graph V E) (hfinite : G.vertexSet.Finite) (n m κ : ℕ) (hn : G.vertexSet.ncard = n) (hm : G.edgeSet.ncard = m) (hκ : x2611_15008_components G = κ) (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 1 < b) (hab : ∀ k : ℤ, 1 ≤ k → 1 + (k : ℝ) * a ≤ 2 * b ^ k) (hloopless : G.Loopless), x2611_15008_Tutte G 1 1 / x2611_15008_Tutte G 2 0 ≤ b ^ m / a ^ (n - κ)) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hA V E _ G hfinite n m κ hn hm hκ a b ha hb hab hloopless
    let _ : Fintype G.vertexSet := hfinite.fintype
    have habN : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → 1 + (k : ℝ) * a ≤ 2 * b ^ k := by
      intro k hk
      simpa using hab (k : ℤ) (by exact_mod_cast hk)
    have hLift := hA (ULift (Fin (Fintype.card G.vertexSet)))
      (ULift (Fin (Fintype.card E)))
    have h := x2611_15008_thm2_loopless_eqv_aux_apply a b
      (fun H _ hH => hLift H a b ha hb habN hH) G
      ((Fintype.equivFin G.vertexSet).trans Equiv.ulift.symm)
      ((Fintype.equivFin E).trans Equiv.ulift.symm) hfinite hloopless
    simpa only [hn, hm, hκ] using h
  · intro hB V E _ _ G a b ha hb hab hG
    have habZ : ∀ k : ℤ, 1 ≤ k → 1 + (k : ℝ) * a ≤ 2 * b ^ k := by
      intro k hk
      lift k to ℕ using (by omega : 0 ≤ k)
      simpa using hab k (by exact_mod_cast hk)
    have hLift := @hB (ULift (Fin (Fintype.card G.vertexSet)))
      (ULift (Fin (Fintype.card E))) inferInstance
    exact x2611_15008_thm2_loopless_eqv_aux_apply a b
      (fun H hf hH => hLift H hf H.vertexSet.ncard H.edgeSet.ncard
        (x2611_15008_components H) rfl rfl rfl a b ha hb habZ hH) G
      ((Fintype.equivFin G.vertexSet).trans Equiv.ulift.symm)
      ((Fintype.equivFin E).trans Equiv.ulift.symm) (Set.toFinite _) hG

statements.label: Theorem 2 (bridgeless inequality)
statements.name: x2611_15008_thm2_bridgeless
statements.original:
Theorem 2.

Let $a>0,~b>1$ so that $1+ka\leq 2b^{k}$ for all integers $k\geq 1$ and $G$ be a graph with $n$ vertices, $m$ edges and $\kappa$ connected components. Then

$\displaystyle\frac{T_{G}(1,1)}{T_{G}(0,2)}\leq\frac{b^{m}}{a^{m-n+\kappa}}$ 
 $\displaystyle\text{if $G$ is bridgeless.}$
statements.lean: (V E : Type*) [Fintype V] [Fintype E] (G : Graph V E) (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 1 < b) (hab : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → 1 + (k : ℝ) * a ≤ 2 * b ^ k) (hG : ∀ e ∈ G.edgeSet, ¬ x2611_15008_bridge G e) : x2611_15008_Tutte G 1 1 / x2611_15008_Tutte G 0 2 ≤ b ^ G.edgeSet.ncard / a ^ (G.edgeSet.ncard + x2611_15008_components G - G.vertexSet.ncard)
statements.notes: Finite multigraphs are represented by Mathlib Graph with finite ambient vertex and edge types; every finite multigraph has such a representation. Counts use the actual vertex/edge sets, not the ambient type sizes. Second inequality only. Bridgeless means that no edge is a bridge; loops are allowed. The exponent m−n+κ is written m+κ−n to avoid an incorrect intermediate truncated subtraction in ℕ. No loopless or connectedness hypothesis is added.

fidelity.twin: {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] (G : Graph V E) (hfinite : G.vertexSet.Finite) (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 1 < b) (hab : ∀ k : ℤ, 1 ≤ k → 1 + (k : ℝ) * a ≤ 2 * b ^ k) (n m κ : ℕ) (hn : G.vertexSet.ncard = n) (hm : G.edgeSet.ncard = m) (hκ : x2611_15008_components G = κ) (hbridgeless : ∀ e : E, ¬ x2611_15008_bridge G e) : x2611_15008_Tutte G 1 1 / x2611_15008_Tutte G 0 2 ≤ b ^ m / a ^ ((m : ℤ) - (n : ℤ) + (κ : ℤ))
fidelity.equivalence_proof:
theorem x2611_15008_thm2_bridgeless_eqv_aux_components
    {V W E : Type*} (G : Graph V E) (f : V → W) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    x2611_15008_components (G.map f) = x2611_15008_components G := by
  let e : G.vertexSet ≃ (G.map f).vertexSet := Equiv.ofBijective
    (fun v => ⟨f v, Set.mem_image_of_mem f v.property⟩)
    ⟨fun u v h => Subtype.ext (hf (congrArg Subtype.val h)), by
      rintro ⟨w, v, hv, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  let i : G.toSimpleGraph ≃g (G.map f).toSimpleGraph :=
    { e with
      map_rel_iff' := by
        intro u v
        change (e u ≠ e v ∧ (G.map f).Adj (f u) (f v)) ↔ (u ≠ v ∧ G.Adj u v)
        rw [e.injective.ne_iff]
        simp only [Graph.map_adj, Relation.Map, hf.eq_iff]
        simp }
  exact (Nat.card_congr i.connectedComponentEquiv).symm

theorem x2611_15008_thm2_bridgeless_eqv_aux_restrict_map
    {V W E : Type*} (G : Graph V E) (f : V → W) (S : Set E) :
    (G.map f).restrict S = (G.restrict S).map f := by
  ext v e x
  · rfl
  · simp only [Graph.restrict_isLink, Graph.map_isLink, Relation.Map]
    aesop

theorem x2611_15008_thm2_bridgeless_eqv_aux_tutte
    {V W E : Type*} [Fintype E] (G : Graph V E) (f : V → W)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (x y : ℝ) :
    x2611_15008_Tutte (G.map f) x y = x2611_15008_Tutte G x y := by
  classical
  have hv : (G.map f).vertexSet.ncard = G.vertexSet.ncard :=
    Set.ncard_image_of_injective _ hf
  unfold x2611_15008_Tutte
  simp only [Graph.edgeSet_map, hv, x2611_15008_thm2_bridgeless_eqv_aux_components G f hf,
    x2611_15008_thm2_bridgeless_eqv_aux_restrict_map,
    x2611_15008_thm2_bridgeless_eqv_aux_components _ f hf]

theorem x2611_15008_thm2_bridgeless_eqv_aux_bridge
    {V W E : Type*} (G : Graph V E) (f : V → W)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (e : E) :
    x2611_15008_bridge (G.map f) e ↔ x2611_15008_bridge G e := by
  have hd : (G.map f).deleteEdges {e} = (G.deleteEdges {e}).map f := by
    simp only [← Graph.restrict_edgeSet_sdiff_eq_deleteEdges, Graph.edgeSet_map,
      x2611_15008_thm2_bridgeless_eqv_aux_restrict_map]
  simp only [x2611_15008_bridge, Graph.edgeSet_map, hd,
    x2611_15008_thm2_bridgeless_eqv_aux_components _ f hf]
theorem x2611_15008_thm2_bridgeless_eqv_aux_edge_bound
    {V E : Type*} [Fintype E] (G : Graph V E) :
    Nat.card G.toSimpleGraph.edgeSet ≤ G.edgeSet.ncard := by
  classical
  choose u v huv using (fun e : G.edgeSet => G.exists_isLink_of_mem_edgeSet e.property)
  let ends : G.edgeSet → Sym2 G.vertexSet := fun e =>
    s(⟨u e, (huv e).left_mem⟩, ⟨v e, (huv e).right_mem⟩)
  have hs : G.toSimpleGraph.edgeSet ⊆ ends '' Set.univ := by
    intro e he
    induction e using Sym2.inductionOn with | _ x y =>
      have ha : x ≠ y ∧ G.Adj x y := he
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := ha.2
      refine ⟨⟨a, ha.edge_mem⟩, Set.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      change s(⟨u ⟨a, ha.edge_mem⟩, _⟩, ⟨v ⟨a, ha.edge_mem⟩, _⟩) = s(x, y)
      rcases (huv ⟨a, ha.edge_mem⟩).eq_and_eq_or_eq_and_eq ha with h | h
      · exact Sym2.eq_iff.mpr (Or.inl ⟨Subtype.ext h.1, Subtype.ext h.2⟩)
      · exact Sym2.eq_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨Subtype.ext h.1, Subtype.ext h.2⟩)
  calc
    Nat.card G.toSimpleGraph.edgeSet = G.toSimpleGraph.edgeSet.ncard := Nat.card_coe_set_eq _
    _ ≤ (ends '' Set.univ).ncard := Set.ncard_le_ncard hs
    _ ≤ (Set.univ : Set G.edgeSet).ncard := Set.ncard_image_le
    _ = G.edgeSet.ncard := by rw [Set.ncard_univ, Nat.card_coe_set_eq]

theorem x2611_15008_thm2_bridgeless_eqv_aux_simple_rank
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] (H : SimpleGraph V) :
    Nat.card V ≤ Nat.card H.edgeSet + Nat.card H.ConnectedComponent := by
  classical
  let : Fintype H.ConnectedComponent := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let f : (Σ c : H.ConnectedComponent, c.toSimpleGraph.edgeSet) → H.edgeSet :=
    fun z => z.1.toSimpleGraph_hom.mapEdgeSet z.2
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    rintro ⟨c, e⟩ ⟨d, e'⟩ h
    have hv := congrArg Subtype.val h
    change Sym2.map (Subtype.val : c → V) e.val =
      Sym2.map (Subtype.val : d → V) e'.val at hv
    have hcd : c = d := by
      rcases e with ⟨e, he⟩
      rcases e' with ⟨e', he'⟩
      induction e using Sym2.inductionOn with | _ u v =>
        induction e' using Sym2.inductionOn with | _ u' v' =>
          simp only [Sym2.map_mk, Sym2.eq_iff] at hv
          rcases hv with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨h, _⟩
          · exact u.property.symm.trans ((congrArg H.connectedComponentMk h).trans u'.property)
          · exact u.property.symm.trans ((congrArg H.connectedComponentMk h).trans v'.property)
    subst d
    have heq : e = e' := Subtype.ext (Sym2.map.injective Subtype.val_injective hv)
    cases heq
    rfl
  have he : (∑ c : H.ConnectedComponent, Nat.card c.toSimpleGraph.edgeSet) ≤
      Nat.card H.edgeSet := by
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_sigma] using Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf
  have hv : (∑ c : H.ConnectedComponent, Nat.card c) = Nat.card V := by
    rw [← Nat.card_sigma]
    exact Nat.card_congr (Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv H.connectedComponentMk)
  calc
    Nat.card V = ∑ c : H.ConnectedComponent, Nat.card c := hv.symm

statements.original:
Lemma 1.

([18])
Let $G$ be a graph and $e\in E(G).$ Then:

(a) 

 $T_{G}(x,y)=T_{G-e}(x,y)+T_{G/e}(x,y)$ if $e$ is neither a loop nor a bridge,

(b) 

 $T_{G}(x,y)=xT_{G-e}(x,y)$ if $e$ is a bridge,

(c) 

 $T_{G}(x,y)=yT_{G-e}(x,y)$ if $e$ is a loop.

(d) 

Furthermore, if $G=G_{1}\cup G_{2},$ where $E(G_{1})\cap E(G_{2})=\emptyset$ and $|V(G_{1})\cap V(G_{2})|\leq 1,$ then $T_{G}(x,y)=T_{G_{1}}(x,y)T_{G_{2}}(x,y).$

statements.original:
Lemma 4.

Let $G$ be a graph, $e\in E(G)$ and $P(e)$ and $S(e)$ be the parallel and series class of $e$ with $|P(e)|=p$ and $|S(e)|=s.$ Then

(a) 

if $P(e)$ is a multiple bridge, then

 $T_{G}(x,y)=xT_{G-P(e)}(x,y)+(y^{p-1}+y^{p-2}+\ldots+y)T_{G/P(e)}(x,y).$

statements.notes: Finite multigraphs are represented by Mathlib Graph with finite ambient vertex and edge types; every finite multigraph has such a representation. Counts use the actual vertex/edge sets, not the ambient type sizes. The descending geometric sum is represented by an ascending finite sum with exactly the same exponents. An empty sum is zero. The identity is evaluated at arbitrary real x,y. Domain ambiguity in the paper: the common introductory hypothesis names both P(e) and S(e), although Section 2 defines the first only for non-loop edges and the second only for non-bridge edges. This literal formalization retains both domain conditions, and both printed cardinality hypotheses |P(e)|=p and |S(e)|=s, even in a subpart using just one class. No identity is extended to an edge outside those shared domains; no global loopless or bridgeless graph hypothesis is added.

statements.original:
Lemma 4.

Let $G$ be a graph, $e\in E(G)$ and $P(e)$ and $S(e)$ be the parallel and series class of $e$ with $|P(e)|=p$ and $|S(e)|=s.$ Then

(b) 

if $P(e)$ is not a multiple bridge, then

 $T_{G}(x,y)=T_{G-P(e)}(x,y)+(y^{p-1}+y^{p-2}+\ldots+1)T_{G/P(e)}(x,y).$

statements.notes: Finite multigraphs are represented by Mathlib Graph with finite ambient vertex and edge types; every finite multigraph has such a representation. Counts use the actual vertex/edge sets, not the ambient type sizes. The descending geometric sum is represented by an ascending finite sum with exactly the same exponents. An empty sum is zero. The identity is evaluated at arbitrary real x,y. Domain ambiguity in the paper: the common introductory hypothesis names both P(e) and S(e), although Section 2 defines the first only for non-loop edges and the second only for non-bridge edges. This literal formalization retains both domain conditions, and both printed cardinality hypotheses |P(e)|=p and |S(e)|=s, even in a subpart using just one class. No identity is extended to an edge outside those shared domains; no global loopless or bridgeless graph hypothesis is added.

    apply (hl _ _ _).mp
    simpa using h

    change l z.val ∈ Quotient.mk _ '' G.vertexSet
    rw [← hzu]
    exact ⟨g u, by rw [hg ⟨u, hu⟩]; exact (p.symm ⟨u, hu⟩).property, rfl⟩

  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨x, y, hxy, hx, hy⟩, he⟩
    refine ⟨⟨g x, g y, hgl hxy, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩

statements.original:
Lemma 5.

Let $G$ be a graph, $e\in E(G),$ and $P(e)$ and $S(e)$ be the parallel and series class of $e$ with $|P(e)|=p$ and $|S(e)|=s.$ Then:

(c) 

if $S(e)$ is a subdivided loop, then

 $T_{G}(0,2)=2T_{G-S(e)}(0,2)\qquad\text{and}\qquad T_{G}(1,1)=sT_{G-S(e)}(1,1),$

(d) 

if $S(e)$ is not a subdivided loop, then

 $T_{G}(0,2)=T_{G-S(e)}(0,2)+T_{G/S(e)}(0,2)\quad\text{and}$ 

 $T_{G}(1,1)=sT_{G-S(e)}(1,1)+T_{G/S(e)}(1,1).\qquad$

statements.notes: Finite multigraphs are represented by Mathlib Graph with finite ambient vertex and edge types; every finite multigraph has such a representation. Counts use the actual vertex/edge sets, not the ambient type sizes. Both evaluations in (c) and both evaluations in (d) are included, guarded by the printed subdivided-loop condition and its negation. Domain ambiguity in the paper: the common introductory hypothesis names both P(e) and S(e), although Section 2 defines the first only for non-loop edges and the second only for non-bridge edges. This literal formalization retains both domain conditions, and both printed cardinality hypotheses |P(e)|=p and |S(e)|=s, even in a subpart using just one class. No identity is extended to an edge outside those shared domains; no global loopless or bridgeless graph hypothesis is added.
